notes: Verification was off (--no-verify): model claims whose quoted evidence is not on the page are reported as if it were. This run is for measurement only.

The page was cut at 5000 elements, the collector's limit: what comes after them is not in the snapshot, so the checks that read the snapshot (Rampa's rules and judged criteria) did not run past that point. Checked only up to the cut: 1.1.1, 1.3.2, 1.3.5, 1.4.3, 1.4.4, 2.4.2, 2.4.4, 2.4.6, 3.1.1, 4.1.2. axe-core read the whole page.

177 image(s) were left without a capture, so no judgment looked at them: 6 outside the page (an off-canvas menu); 3 transparent where it sits; 168 over the limit of images captured per page. The snapshot says why for each (native.imageSkipped).

The model judged at most 50 candidates per criterion on this page (--max-candidates), those with a generic text first; it did not judge 108 of 158 for 2.4.4, 7 of 57 for 2.4.6. The coverage lists them as not judged.

Not checked on a single page: 3.2.3 Consistent Navigation, 3.2.4 Consistent Identification and 3.2.6 Consistent Help compare the pages of a site, 2.4.5 Multiple Ways lists the ways to find them, and 2.4.1 Bypass Blocks needs them to tell the blocks that repeat from the content; crawl its address with --crawl or --sitemap.
